update.installFailed: Could not install the update automatically. Download it manually below.
update.autoHint: The update downloads in the background, then the app restarts on its own. Your settings and cache stay.
update.autoHintWindows: The update downloads in the background, the installer runs for a few seconds and the app restarts on its own. Your settings and cache stay.
update.hintInstaller: Quit the app from the tray first (right-click the icon, then Quit), otherwise the old version keeps running. Then run the installer: it installs over the current version and keeps your settings.
update.hintMac: Quit the app (Cmd+Q), open the downloaded dmg and drag the app into Applications, replacing the old one.
update.hintPortable: This is the portable version. Quit the app from the tray (right-click the icon, then Quit) and replace the old exe with the downloaded one. Your settings stay. Want one-click updates? Install the setup.exe version instead.
update.hintAppImage: Quit the app, replace the old AppImage with the downloaded one and make it executable:
update.hintDeb: Download the new package, install it over the current one and restart the app:
update.hintRpm: Download the new package, install it over the current one and restart the app:
update.hintAur: Installed from the AUR. The soundcloud-bin package is updated within a minute of every release, so just update it with your AUR helper:
update.hintFlatpak: Update it from your app center or with the first command. If it says there is nothing to update, this copy came from an older bundle without an update source: download the new bundle and reinstall it once with the second command. Plain install over it fails with "Directory not empty".
update.hintSource: This build was compiled from source: run git pull and rebuild it.
